motion_GT_comparison.definition: same source-pixel rigid surface local point transformed at source/query frames; query-source world displacement
motion_GT_comparison.units: meters, using the same known model-to-world scale and first-camera rotation as input normalization
motion_GT_comparison.source_support: only source-visible finite surface points; GT displacement from rigid transforms even when target occluded, never filled with zero for invisibility
motion_GT_comparison.target_visibility: dynamic correspondence only: exact mesh first-hit/GT-object visibility, tolerance1e-4m, inside512image
motion_GT_comparison.source_sampling: Exact mesh first-hit source rays at nominal518pixel centers; RGB was bicubic-resized512-to518; target visibility/reprojection at native512
motion_GT_comparison.limitation: BF16 conditioning of model poses/intrinsics remains; displacement/GT-source reprojection do not by themselves validate predicted source depth
